Native R graphics for generalized function-on-scalar and mixed-effects scientific inference

etr_native_generalized_mixed_source_graphics.Rd

Plot fitted generalized function-on-scalar predictions, contrast bands, coefficient functions, covariance sensitivity and mixed-effects residual dependence with explicit observed-grid numerical geometry.

Usage

etr_plot_covariance_sensitivity_band_widths(
  result, coefficient, strict_source_record = FALSE)

Arguments

result

An explicitly declared scientific fitted R record or pre-calibrated band/sensitivity/residual diagnostics R record.

coefficient

Exact declared source regression coefficient name.

strict_source_record

If TRUE, return explicitly typed native source-scientific artist geometry rather than default base R plot output.

Value

Base-R graphics on the active device and invisible numeric plot geometry on the declared time grid. Python Matplotlib Axes output is not returned and one-to-one backend object equivalence is not claimed.

Details

The source's link or response scale, covariance sensitivity reference, simultaneous observed-grid interval labels, zero lines for differences or ACF and one line for rate ratios are preserved. No inference, bootstrap refitting, model selection, or calibration is performed. Physical lag means are not mistaken for regular index lags. All seven independent source-contract approvals remain unresolved.
